ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW: Test PR may be auto-closed by ci-trigger or branch-protection rules

Add consideration: '[Reliability] The deliberate-violation PR may interact unpredictably with branch protection rules introduced via .github/required-checks.txt and the github-bootstrap.sh provisioning. Verify the test PR is opened against a sandbox branch or behind a feature flag so it cannot accidentally merge if a check is misconfigured. Use a label or draft state to prevent gh pr merge --auto from queuing on it.'
